dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi! When does the English course start?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! ˈwɛn dʌz ði ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌkɔːrs ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: On Monday, June 2nd, at six thirty p.m.
dialogue.reading: ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, ˈdʒuːn ˈsɛkənd, ət ˈsɪks ˈθɜːrti ˌpiːˈɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Do I need a placement test?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! duː aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈpleɪsmənt ˌtɛst?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. It's on Friday, here at the language school.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ, ˈhɪr ət ðə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˌskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. And what do I need for the first day?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈwʌt duː aɪ ˈniːd fər ðə ˌfɜːrst ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Just one photo for your member card.
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒʌst ˈwʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ fər jʊr ˈmɛmbər ˌkɑːrd.
